CCNA301V2-0000029.title: Ansible playbook
CCNA301V2-0000029.content:
- name: Collect access-switch interface status
  hosts: access_switches
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Run interface status command
      cisco.ios.ios_command:
        commands:
          - show interfaces status
      register: interface_status

    - name: Display returned lines
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: interface_status.stdout_lines
